definition.en: Money is any item or verifiable record that is generally accepted as payment for goods and services and repayment of debts in a particular country or socio-economic context.
definition.hi: Money is any item or verifiable record that is generally accepted as payment for goods and services and repayment of debts in a particular country or socio-economic context.

importanceInUpsc.en: Understanding the concept of money is fundamental to mastering the Indian Economy syllabus for UPSC GS-3. It provides the theoretical foundation for analyzing monetary policy, inflation, and the role of the Reserve Bank of India in managing the financial system.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Understanding the concept of money is fundamental to mastering the Indian Economy syllabus for UPSC GS-3. It provides the theoretical foundation for analyzing monetary policy, inflation, and the role of the Reserve Bank of India in managing the financial system.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the evolution and essential characteristics of money.
